description: Standard extraction and normalization on a complete, valid regulatory document without discrepancies.
purpose: Verify standard extraction and normalization on a complete, valid regulatory document without discrepancies.

description: Detection of omitted mandatory fields producing explicit null normalized values and missing-field rule flags.
purpose: Verify that omitted mandatory fields (e.g., missing academic_year) produce explicit null normalized values and missing-field rule flags.
expected_findings: Mandatory field 'academic_year' missing from document payload

description: Validation failure when application ID or permanent institute ID violates standard regex formatting.
purpose: Detect malformed application numbers or permanent institute IDs that violate standard AICTE format (e.g., non-numeric characters).

description: Validation failure when validity end date precedes validity start date.
purpose: Detect inverted or impossible validity intervals (e.g., valid_to precedes valid_from).
notes: Synthetic test case: simulated OCR confidence values are test-only indicators and not real engine output.
expected_findings: Accreditation valid_to '2024-05-01' is earlier than valid_from '2025-06-01'

description: Cross-document validation failure when an institution submits two documents declaring conflicting Permanent Institute IDs.
purpose: Verify cross-validation detection when an institution submits two documents declaring conflicting Permanent Institute IDs.
expected_findings: Permanent Institute ID mismatch between EoA (1-4775731) and Disclosure (1-9999999)

description: Cross-document validation failure when claimed programme intake exceeds AICTE approved intake quota.
purpose: Catch discrepancies between intake claimed in Mandatory Disclosure and intake approved in AICTE EoA.
expected_findings: Intake for Computer Science exceeds approved quota: claimed 180, approved 120

description: Integrity check failure when identical document hash is submitted across multiple sessions.
purpose: Detect duplicate submissions with identical payload or checksum for the same application session.
expected_findings: Document sha256 checksum matches existing submission doc_id 'DOC_REAL_003'

description: Routing to human review when simulated OCR engine confidence falls below acceptance threshold (0.65).
purpose: Flag values extracted via OCR where engine confidence is below acceptance threshold (0.65) or characters are ambiguous (O vs 0).
notes: Synthetic test case: simulated OCR confidence values are test-only indicators and not real engine output.
expected_findings: CGPA field extracted with low confidence (0.48 < 0.65 threshold)

description: Structured parser failure handling when input binary stream is truncated or corrupt.
purpose: Ensure corrupt or truncated input produces a structured processing failure instead of an unhandled crash.
expected_findings: Input stream is corrupted or not a valid PDF structure

description: Routing to human reviewer when conflicting values are extracted from different pages of the same document.
purpose: Flag cases with conflicting extracted values on different pages or partial OCR recognition requiring human adjudication.
notes: Synthetic test case: simulated OCR confidence values are test-only indicators and not real engine output.
expected_findings: Conflicting accreditation expiry dates detected across page 1 and page 3
